title: Maple Banana Baked Oatmeal with Walnuts
changes_from_base: Baked rather than simmered: oats, walnuts and baking powder go into a dish over sliced banana, a maple, egg and milk mix is poured over and the whole thing bakes until just set.
summary: Soft and moist baked oatmeal with banana throughout and the welcome nuttiness of walnuts, sweetened with maple and fragrant with cinnamon.

ingredients.item: unsalted butter, melted, plus a little for the dish
fine sea salt or table salt
ripe bananas (2 sliced into rounds, 1 mashed)
maple syrup, plus more to serve

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Preheat oven to 175 °C (155 °C fan) and butter a 20 x 28 cm baking dish.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Combine 135 g rolled oats, 60 g chopped walnuts, 1 tsp baking powder, ½ tsp cinnamon and ¼ tsp salt in a large bowl.

steps.title: Arrange
steps.text: Lay 2 sliced bananas in the dish and scatter the oat mix over.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Mash the third banana, then whisk in 80 ml maple syrup, 1 large egg, 420 ml milk, 28 g melted butter and 1 tsp vanilla; pour evenly over the oats and tap so it soaks in.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Scatter remaining walnuts and 12 g dark brown sugar over the top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 30-35 min until golden and centre reaches 71 °C.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Let rest 5 min before serving with extra maple syrup.

tips: Pour the maple, egg and milk mixture slowly and evenly over the oats so every part soaks it up and the whole dish sets evenly.
Slice one banana into rounds first so it holds its shape in the oatmeal.
Slice the dish into portions while still warm for cleaner cuts.
safety: Use an instant-read thermometer to check that the centre has reached 71 °C for food safety.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 4 days; reheat individual portions in the microwave 1-2 min until warm. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
